_comment: Route-regression cases for my-llm-wiki-maintainer. should_trigger = real maintainer operations (write/maintain). near_neighbor = my-llm-wiki capture requests (fetch/clip/archive a NEW source into RAW) AND my-llm-wiki-search read-only lookups (查一下知识库 / wiki 里搜 / what does my wiki say) that must NOT route here. should_not_trigger = generic explain/summarize/translate. Run with yao-meta-skill scripts/trigger_eval.py against evals/route/semantic_config.json.

should_trigger.text: Ingest the new raw sources into wiki pages and run the review queue.
Flush the inbox — synthesize every raw source not yet compiled into pages.
Re-ingest the changed sources and merge them into the existing pages.
Compile the raw sources in this wiki into interlinked pages.
Run deep research on the gaps in the review queue and ingest the findings back.
Sweep the stale review items and resolve the ones that are done.
Dedup the wiki — merge the duplicate entity pages saved under different names.
Lint my knowledge base and show me the broken wikilinks.
Save that answer back into the wiki so the knowledge compounds.
Refresh the overview page for this wiki.
Initialize a new LLM Wiki with purpose.md, schema.md, and wiki/index.md.
把这个 wiki 里已沉淀的 raw 源编译成相互链接的页面。
维护我的 LLM Wiki：跑一遍 review 队列，处理收件箱里的新源。
对知识库做 lint，检查坏链和缺失的 frontmatter。
从 wiki 里带引用回答这个问题，然后把答案回存。
对这个知识库去重，把重名的实体页合并成一个。
刷新这个 wiki 的 overview 概览页。

near_neighbor.text: Save this 公众号 article to my wiki.
Clip this X post into my knowledge base.
Archive this link as a faithful Markdown original with its images.
Fetch this URL and download the images locally into RAW.
Sync my Twitter bookmarks into the RAW layer.
Distill this YouTube video into RAW as a timestamped transcript.
File my idea as a note in the wiki.
把这个链接存进知识库，存成 raw。
同步我的 X 收藏到 RAW。
把这个视频存进知识库。
记一下我的想法，存个 idea 到 wiki。
Answer this question from the wiki with citations and wikilinks.
查一下知识库里有没有关于 MCP 的内容。
What does my wiki say about prompt caching?
之前存过关于 SEO 的文章吗？
Search my knowledge base for notes on Rust async.

should_not_trigger.text: Explain what an LLM wiki is in simple terms.
总结一下这篇文章的重点。
解释一下知识库是什么意思。
